method: Read live US autocomplete and competing apps with free tools. Prioritize feature relevance and narrower search intent. Apple guidance used for limits, duplication and prohibited competitor terms. No paid account or campaign created.
strategy: Keep broad cheap gas prices in title. Highlight E85 and diesel station finding in subtitle. Hidden tokens extend locator, nearby, map, premium, comparison and trend searches without exact duplicates. Other fuel-grade tokens are feature-derived, not proven-demand winners.
excluded: Cashback and rewards unsupported by app
E85 blend or mix calculator searches unsupported by app
Repair and game searches unrelated to fuel discovery
limitations: Difficulty scores are tool-specific heuristics, not Apple scores or ranking guarantees.
Autocomplete ordering is not search volume and includes branded app names.
No conversion or ranking lift can be measured before public launch.
93 and 91 are premium-grade discovery terms; app does not guarantee exact station octane.
nextMeasurement: After release, compare App Store Search impressions, product-page conversion and downloads in App Store Connect. Reassess targeted terms after enough traffic; avoid claiming causation from an uncontrolled before-after comparison.
